nodes.label: Direct .pro Writing Safety Gate
nodes.rationale: Unofficial direct .pro writing must remain disabled until sanitized presentations round-trip and pass manual verification on Windows and macOS.

nodes.label: ProPresenter Compatibility Gate
nodes.rationale: Compatibility is restricted to the locally verified ProPresenter 19.0.1 and document 10/build 26200 combination; unsupported versions must leave presentation files unchanged.

nodes.label: Unofficial Schema Safety Policy
nodes.rationale: Reverse-engineered schemas are unsupported by Renewed Vision, so every newly enabled version requires explicit compatibility gating and sanitized golden-fixture evidence.
